tools.name: blueprint_backup_status
tools.title: 核對工作台備份
tools.description: Owner-only native maintenance status with current consistent coverage, platform integrity/restore evidence and this authenticated account’s client-attested private-copy receipt. A reusable flag is not deployment or current chat acceptance. Recheck immediately before a protected change. Legacy backups without coverage cannot qualify. Supply operation_id to read that persisted backup_request (including unknown results) instead of relying on the latest backup; reading never queues another copy.

tools.name: blueprint_backup_create
tools.title: 建立完整私人備份
tools.description: Queue a complete private backup on the native backend. For retry-safe v2 calls supply contract_version=2 with the same operation_id and plan_digest; read status before retrying an unknown result. The same operation returns its existing backup ID without repackaging. Empty legacy calls remain supported. A queued result is not completion or a downloaded private copy.

tools.name: blueprint_backup_artifact
tools.title: 取得私人備份下載資料
tools.description: Read metadata for this existing backup ID and its protected same-origin download_path. No token, public URL or ZIP contents are returned. Download through an authenticated supported client, verify size/SHA256, then record a client receipt. An unknown download result must reuse this ID.

tools.name: blueprint_backup_private_copy
tools.title: 記錄私人副本核對
tools.description: Record the authenticated owner’s client attestation after reading a real private downloaded file. Supply its private file reference, exact size and SHA256 with readback_verified=true. The backend compares archive integrity but cannot verify the remote filesystem or claim off-host durability. Never include credentials or a public link.

tools.name: blueprint_operation_read
tools.title: 讀取安裝更新進度
tools.description: Read this authenticated owner’s private operation by ID, or list their operations when ID is omitted. Read before retrying an unknown write, creating another backup or publishing. Saved progress is evidence supplied by the client, not proof that deployment or acceptance occurred.

tools.name: blueprint_operation_write
tools.title: 接續安裝更新進度
tools.description: Create or CAS-update an owner-only private operation. Reuse operation_id, plan_digest and request_id with identical arguments on retry; a changed plan or stale version conflicts. changes_json is a JSON object with stage, target_services, protected_services, layout_change, change_type, sources, evidence and next_step. Stages advance discover → plan → backup_gate → apply → publish_if_needed → verify → complete; waiting_user preserves the stage to resume. This records progress only and never performs deployment.
